vectors.intent_statement: Restore reproducible Research build gates before provenance can be produced.
Authorize and track ten staging build-repair steps with explicit failure reporting.
Declare the real build gates and exact staging toolchain without replacing runtime dependencies.
Describe governance metadata for package.json without changing its file format.
Use the same supported Node runtime locally and in CI.
Describe governance metadata for .nvmrc without changing its file format.
Typecheck all Research source strictly and emit compiled output only when the build is valid.
Describe governance metadata for tsconfig.json without changing its file format.
Lint TypeScript and test code with recommended rules instead of an absent ESLint configuration.
Keep installed dependencies, build output and local secrets out of review.
Prevent local dependency trees and environment files from entering Docker builds.
Verify the existing public health response without production or event-bus connections.
Prevent stale output from surviving a clean build while preserving source files.
Keep strict build checks, pinned runtimes, real dependencies and security scans mandatory.
Document reproducible build recovery and distinguish offline checks from a successful clean build.
Apply the operator-authorized build-repair scope while retaining staging boundaries.
Direct IDE seats to the active build-repair dispatch and its dependency limitations.
Record active build-repair scope and confirmed guild ownership.
Register the authorized build SRS while retaining prior governance and Living World work.
Retain signing trust-boundary checks while requiring typechecking and lockfile packaging.
Describe remaining administrator activation and build-locking requirements accurately.
Verify signed archives that include compiled output and its dependency lockfile.
Require pinned build gates before signing the actual compiled archive and dependency lockfile.
Apply the pinned runtime and strict typecheck gate while preserving CI publication boundaries.
Require lint and typechecking before existing release publication on the pinned runtime.
Retain CodeQL and secret scanning with the same Node runtime as the build.
Align container compilation and runtime with the pinned Node release.
Document build gates and dependency recovery before starting the real Research SDK.
Report completed staging repairs and unresolved clean-install/compiler blockers without claiming success.
Preserve build-repair file intent, dependencies and verified test outcomes for dispatch ingestion.
Describe the build-dispatch JSON memory payload without invalid JSON comments.

vectors.description: Offline real lockfile generation failed with ENOTCACHED for the SDK; npm ci failed because no lockfile exists. No synthetic dependency metadata was added.
Strict typecheck and build failed because Node types, NATS and SDK are unavailable. The failed build produced no dist artifact. Python strict mypy is blocked by missing PyYAML stubs.
Fixed the initial lint URL-global error with an explicit node:url import; lint passes using preinstalled sandbox tools. Five Node tests pass and loaded health.ts coverage is 100%.
All sixteen governance/build policy checks pass; twenty-three workflow shell steps pass syntax validation. Live CI, Docker and signing were not run.
